name: Assistante des convois
description: Young fully adult female with lean long limbs, cool grey mottled skin, tapered exposed head, short fine mandibles, shoulder-length black dreads with copper ties. Simple tan cross-wrap tunic and knee trousers, narrow bronze forearm plates. Holds two small sealed ration packs bound together with leather cord and a compact water canteen; modest soft backpack. Easy waiting posture with one bent knee.
